# Actions and controls Most actions use the controls you already have. They are not on the wheel, so this page lists them. Each one costs 1 action unless it says otherwise.
## Fighting - [bold]Left-click in combat mode:[/bold] Strike. Aim roughly toward an enemy in reach and you hit the closest one. Neutral creatures have to be clicked. - [bold]Right-click in combat mode:[/bold] a wide swing. With an empty hand, a shield, or a weapon with the shove or disarm trait, it Shoves or Disarms instead. A weapon with the trip trait Trips. - [bold]Use in hand (Z), a weapon with several damage types:[/bold] switches to the next type, for 1 action. The hand panel shows which is set. - [bold]Throw a weapon with the thrown trait:[/bold] a ranged Strike at the first enemy it touches. It flies to your cursor, up to six times its range. Past its range you take a penalty, and a spear sticks in what it hits. - [bold]Pull a living enemy:[/bold] Grapple. Press a move key while grabbed to Escape. - [bold]Ctrl and right-click while grabbing an enemy:[/bold] Reposition it. - [bold]Run into an enemy and keep pushing:[/bold] Tumble Through. It uses Acrobatics against their Reflex. Walking never tumbles. - [bold]Run out of an enemy's reach:[/bold] An enemy with Reactive Strike or a similar reaction gets a free Strike at you. Walking out is a Step instead: it costs 1 action and is safe, but with no actions left you are caught anyway.
## Pointing in combat mode - [bold]At an enemy in reach:[/bold] Feint. You need to be trained in Deception. A success leaves it off-guard to your next melee attack, a critical success to all your melee attacks for 6 seconds. If your class marks enemies, the first point marks and the second Feints. - [bold]At an enemy further away:[/bold] your class mark, if you have one. - [bold]At the ground:[/bold] Seek. You search a 30-foot area for hidden creatures and traps.
## Emotes in combat mode Pick these from the emote wheel. Typing them is only roleplay. - [bold]Scream:[/bold] Demoralize the enemy you are aiming at, within 30 feet. - [bold]Whistle:[/bold] Create a Diversion. Nearby enemies you fool lose sight of you.
## Staying out of sight - [bold]Right-click cover, then Hide:[/bold] you need cover from an enemy to hide from it. Shutting yourself in a closet also works, and costs no action. - [bold]Walk while hidden:[/bold] Sneak. It spends an action every couple of seconds, and the result is secret. Running, or doing anything else, gives you away.
## Light and darkness A creature in dim light is concealed from you unless you have low-light vision or darkvision: you need a 5 or more on a flat check to affect it. One in darkness is hidden unless you have darkvision: you need an 11 or more, and it attacks you as an unseen attacker does. Night outdoors is dim. A torch is bright for half its reach and dim beyond that. Your adventurer's kit has a torch and a lighter. When you stand in dim light or darkness yourself, the row of conditions above your hit points says so, and you can Hide there with no cover from anyone who cannot see in it.
## Cover A wall or a corner between you and an attacker is cover: +2 to your AC, or +4 when almost all of you is behind it. It also adds to Reflex saves against an area that starts on the far side. Another creature standing in the line of an attack gives +1 to AC. Cover does not add to a raised shield: the larger of the two counts. - [bold]Take Cover, on the Common tab:[/bold] with cover from an enemy, it becomes greater cover (1 action). Lying prone, you get greater cover against ranged attacks with nothing to hide behind. It lasts until you leave the spot or attack.
## Keys of their own These have no button. Change the keys under Options, Controls, CarpFinder. - [bold]L:[/bold] Trip the enemy you are aiming at (1 action). You need a free hand, or a weapon with the trip trait. Athletics against Reflex: a success knocks it prone, and a critical failure puts you on the ground. - [bold]J:[/bold] Long Jump the way you face (2 actions). Athletics: you jump 5 feet for every 5 you roll, up to your Speed, and at least as far as a Leap. - [bold]Shift+J:[/bold] High Jump (2 actions). Athletics against DC 30 to clear 5 feet straight up.
## Right-click yourself - [bold]Perform:[/bold] a Performance check everyone near can see the result of (1 action). - [bold]Forage (Subsist):[/bold] 12 seconds and a Survival check for a ration. You can try once every 15 minutes. - [bold]Look for tracks (Track):[/bold] 3 seconds and a Survival check, trained only. On a success you see the trails creatures have left for a minute. - [bold]Cover your tracks:[/bold] trained in Survival. You move at half Speed and leave no trail until you stop.
## Right-click something else - [bold]A creature that is not your ally, then Steal:[/bold] Thievery against its Perception, at -5 (1 action). On a success you take what is in one of its pockets and it does not notice. - [bold]A poisoned creature, or yourself, then Treat Poison:[/bold] with a healer's toolkit in hand and training in Medicine (1 action). A success gives +2 to the next save against the poison. Treat Disease is the same for a disease, and takes 12 seconds. - [bold]A damaged shield, then Repair:[/bold] 12 seconds and a Crafting check. A success restores 5 Hit Points and 5 more for each rank you have in Crafting.
## Helping - [bold]Click a creature with a healer's toolkit:[/bold] Treat Wounds. It takes 12 seconds and 3 actions spread across them, and needs training in Medicine. You hold your patient still until it is done, and if they break free it ends. - [bold]Right-click a verdant seed in your hand:[/bold] grow it into a staff, a spear or a sling (1 action). Right-click the weapon to turn it back into the seed (1 action). Druids with Verdant Weapon have one. - [bold]Throw a healing potion:[/bold] it breaks. On a living creature it heals them as if they drank it. Anywhere else it leaves a puddle, good for 5 minutes, that heals whoever lies prone in it or drinks it (alt-click the puddle). - [bold]Combat mode, left-click a tree with a hatchet or battle axe:[/bold] chop it. No attack roll: a tree falls in 3 swings, a large one in 5, and drops logs. Click a log with the axe, out of combat mode, to split it into planks. - [bold]Combat mode, left-click rock or an ore vein with a pick:[/bold] mine it. No attack roll: a small rock breaks in 3 swings, a cave wall or vein in 4, a big rock in 5. Against creatures all three are still weapons and roll to hit. - [bold]Use a healer's toolkit in hand in combat mode:[/bold] Battle Medicine on the nearest hurt ally, if you have the feat. - [bold]Right-click an ally, then Aid:[/bold] help with their next check. - [bold]Buckle into a bed, then click the Sleep icon on the right of the screen, under the temperature and pressure icons:[/bold] a long rest. It restores your Hit Points, spell slots and focus points. While you sleep the icon is Wake: click it to get up. - [bold]Click the Look up icon on the right of the screen:[/bold] when there is a level above you, it shows that level wherever its floor is open. Click it again to look back down. - [bold]Examine a creature, then the information icon:[/bold] Recall Knowledge. You get one try per creature.
## Feats that use these controls - [bold]Double Slice, Twin Feint:[/bold] right-click one creature with a melee weapon in each hand. 2 actions. - [bold]Vicious Swing:[/bold] right-click one creature. 2 actions. With two or more creatures in the arc, it stays a wide swing. - [bold]Snagging Strike, Exacting Strike, Tumble Behind:[/bold] these happen on their own. - [bold]Finishers:[/bold] Alt and Z with your weapon in hand, aimed at an enemy in reach, performs the finisher the weapon is set to. It starts on Confident Finisher. Use the weapon in your hand (Z) to switch to the next finisher you know: the hand panel shows which. - [bold]Misfires:[/bold] a firearm that misfires is jammed, and examining it says so. Pull the trigger or reload to clear it, for 1 action. Loading a one-handed firearm or crossbow needs your other hand empty. - [bold]A Gunslinger's initial deed:[/bold] it happens on its own as a fight begins, and draws your weapon from your belt, back or neck. - [bold]Courageous Anthem:[/bold] use the wheel for a minute of it, or play a held instrument and it lasts as long as the music. The music plays on with the instrument window closed, while the instrument stays in your hands.
## Languages Press the speech bubble button on the top bar to open the language menu, and choose the language you speak. You always read your own words. Anyone else who does not know the language hears nonsense, and the same word always sounds the same. Your ancestry teaches you some languages, and each point of Intelligence adds one more.
## Still on the wheel Spells, Leap, Rage, Flurry of Blows, Spellstrike, Sudden Charge, and Point-Blank Stance.
